name: FTII Scholarships (merit and merit-cum-means) for Film and Television Wing students
provider: Film and Television Institute of India (FTII), Pune

value: Film and Television Institute of India
rules.quote: The Film and Television Institute of India (FTII) provides scholarships and financial assistance to support meritorious and financially deserving students pursuing film and television education.
Scholarships are awarded to eligible students of Film Wing and Television Wing courses based on merit, financial need, and prescribed eligibility criteria.

rules.value: most awards are by rank (topper) in entrance exam or semester SGPA/CGPA
rules.quote: SEMESTER-WISE SCHOLARSHIPS STRUCTURE (AS PER ACADEMIC COUNCIL MEETING DATED 07.04.2026)

rules.value: Kaifi Azmi award is merit plus income based

amount.text: Varies by award, roughly Rs 6,000 to Rs 1,00,000 per scholarship (e.g. Rs 25,000 / 22,500 for toppers)
